shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!build'"' | head -200"
/bin/bash -c 'cat package.json'
/bin/bash -c "cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- index.html ---\\n' && cat index.html"
/bin/bash -c 'test -d node_modules && echo node_modules_exists || echo no_node_modules; ls node_modules | head -50 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/react-markdown 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -c "node -e \"const g=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json'); console.log(g.version)\" 2>/dev/null || true; ls src"

/bin/bash -c "ls node_modules | rg -i 'markdown|remark|marked|micromark|mdast|hast|unified' || true; echo '---@uiw---'; ls node_modules/@uiw 2>/dev/null; echo '---@hello-pangea---'; ls node_modules/@hello-pangea 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -c "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg -i 'textarea|text-area|yfm|markdown' | head -50; echo '---components---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100"

/bin/bash -c "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout; echo '---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg -i 'form|field'; echo '---text input---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls | head -60"

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts; echo '---TextInput---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true; echo '---Card---'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; echo '---Flex---'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; echo '---Text---'; sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "npm view react-markdown version 2>/dev/null; npm view remark-gfm version 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version 2>/dev/null || echo 'no markdown-editor access'"
/bin/bash -c "find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' | sort; echo '---git---'; git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -c 'cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs'
/bin/bash -c "cat tsconfig.json; echo '---vite---'; cat vite.config.ts; echo '---gitignore---'; cat .gitignore; echo '---lock head---'; sed -n '1,60p' package-lock.json"
/bin/bash -c 'npm install react-markdown@''^10.1.0 remark-gfm@''^4.0.1'

/bin/bash -c "node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p,null,2))\" | sed -n '1,40p'; echo '---check versions---'; node -e \"console.log(require('react-markdown/package.json').version, require('remark-gfm/package.json').version)\""

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | sed -n '1,60p'; echo '---Card types---'; rg -n \"type CardType|type CardView|type CardTheme|type CardSize\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card -g '*.d.ts'; echo '---Divider---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Divider/Divider.d.ts | sed -n '1,40p'; echo '---Label---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | sed -n '1,40p'"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"export.*Flex|Flex\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head; echo '---layout index---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts; echo '---root index exports grep TextArea/Card/Text/Flex/Divider---'; rg -n \"TextArea|Card|Text|Flex|Divider|Container|Button\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -40"
/bin/bash -c 'rg -n "TextArea|Card|Text|Flex|Divider|Container|Button" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -80'
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts"
/bin/bash -c 'rg -n "TextArea|Card|Text|Flex|Divider|Container|Button|TextInput" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -80'
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/react-markdown/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/react-markdown/lib/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls node_modules/react-markdown"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts; echo '---Col---'; sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Col/Col.d.ts"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/react-markdown/lib/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/App.tsx')
s = p.read_text()
s = \"import './App.css';\\n\\nimport { useMemo, useState } from 'react';\\n\" + s.split(\"import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';\\n\",1)[1]
p.write_text(s)
print(p.read_text().splitlines()[0:5])
PY"
/bin/bash -c 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -c "cat src/App.tsx; echo '--- CSS ---'; cat src/App.css; echo '--- deps ---'; node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.dependencies,null,2))\""
